answer: Registration fees escalate: each new identity pays an entry stake that doubles after every 25 sign-ups in the prior hour, locked as an anchor bond for 40 epochs. Newcomers sit on a probation reef at 0.05 grading weight until 5 peer audits pass. The 1,000th fake in one hour pays 2^39 times the first entry stake. Weakness: slow trickle signup. Fix: an echo detector flags shared funding trails or >0.85 answer-embedding matches among recent registrants; 5 random established graders then raise that cohort's next fee tier two steps.
